---
title: "Cases"
---

Twenty-seven cases: ten tests from Spada et al. (2011), five from Martinec et
al. (2018), and the twelve GIAMIP experiments. Each is a JSON file in
`giamip/resources/cases/`, and this page is generated from those files.

None of them has been run. A case here is a specification: what earth model,
what load, over what time, on what grid, with which constants, and what to
compare against.

Each Spada test also has its own page, which shows its settings, its loads and
its earth model. The "Published as" column of the Spada table links to it.

```{python}
#| echo: false
import sys, pathlib
sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path("../..").resolve()))
from IPython.display import Markdown
from giamip import cases
out = []

out.append("## Spada et al. (2011)\n")
out.append("| Case | Published as | Title | Class | Earth model | Contributors |")
out.append("| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |")
for c in cases.cases("spada2011"):
    # The published name links to the test's own page, which shows its inputs.
    page = c["id"].removeprefix("spada2011-")
    out.append(f"| `{c['id']}` | [{c['published_name']}](../cases/spada2011/{page}.py) | "
               f"{c['title']} | "
               f"{c['test_class']} | {c['earth_model']} | "
               f"{', '.join(c['reference_data']['contributors'])} |")

out.append("\n## Martinec et al. (2018)\n")
out.append("| Case | Title | SLE | Ice | Time | Basin | Terminal time | Contributors | Data held |")
out.append("| --- | --- | ---: | --- | --- | --- | ---: | --- | --- |")
for c in cases.cases("martinec2018"):
    s = c["specification"]
    held = "yes" if c["reference_data"].get("archive") else "no"
    out.append(f"| `{c['id']}` | {c['title']} | {s['sea_level_equation']} | "
               f"{s['ice_height_model']} | {s['time_scenario']} | {s['ocean_basin']} | "
               f"{s['terminal_time_kyr']} kyr | "
               f"{', '.join(c['reference_data']['contributors'])} | {held} |")

out.append("\n## GIAMIP\n")
out.append("| Experiment | Tier | Ice history | Viscosity | Elastic | Rheology | Topography | Start |")
out.append("| --- | ---: | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | ---: |")
for c in cases.cases("giamip"):
    e, t = c["earth"], c["topography"]
    out.append(f"| `{c['experiment_id']}` | {c['tier']} | {c['forcing']['ice_history']} | "
               f"{e['viscosity']} | {e['elastic_structure']} | {e['rheology']} | "
               f"{t['model']} | {c['period']['start_ka_before_2000ce']} ka |")
Markdown("\n".join(out))
```

## Full specification of one case

```{python}
#| echo: false
import sys, pathlib
sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path("../..").resolve()))
from IPython.display import Markdown
import json
from giamip import cases
out = []
for c in cases.cases():
    out.append(f"### `{c['id']}`\n")
    if c.get("title"):
        out.append(f"**{c['title']}**\n")
    if c.get("description"):
        out.append(c["description"] + "\n")
    out.append("```json\n" + json.dumps(c, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n```\n")
Markdown("\n".join(out))
```
